connector.name: Frenchie
connector.registryDescription: OCR, transcription, file extraction, and image generation for AI agents via MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.getfrenchie.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package frenchie. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lab94 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer fr_... — your Frenchie API key

headers.name: X-Frenchie-Default-Language
headers.description: Optional ISO 639-1 language hint (e.g. 'th', 'en', 'ja') applied to transcribe_to_markdown when the tool input does not specify a language. Tool-level language always wins.

env.name: FRENCHIE_API_KEY
env.description: Your Frenchie API key (starts with fr_). Create one at https://getfrenchie.dev/dashboard/api-keys — first signup comes with 100 free credits.

env.name: FRENCHIE_DEFAULT_LANGUAGE
env.description: Optional ISO 639-1 language hint (e.g. 'th', 'en', 'ja') applied to transcribe_to_markdown when the tool input does not specify a language. Tool-level language always wins.
